source_first_checklist.observation: Four separate capacities: making/being subject of fixed valuations; making/being subject of market-value vows. Five listed groups all included.
source_first_checklist.source_text: מתני׳ הכל מעריכין ונערכין נודרין ונידרין כהנים לוים וישראלים נשים ועבדים

source_first_checklist.observation: Tumtum/androgynos can vow, be vowed for and evaluate, but not be fixed-valued. Definite male/female condition concerns valuation subjects, not actors.
source_first_checklist.source_text: טומטום ואנדרוגינוס נודרין ונידרין ומעריכין אבל לא נערכין שאינו נערך אלא הזכר ודאי ונקבה ודאית

source_first_checklist.observation: Deaf-mute, cognitively incapable and minor can be subjects of both types, but cannot initiate either owing to lack of daat. Next segment qualifies minor actor rule.
source_first_checklist.source_text: חרש שוטה וקטן נידרין ונערכין אבל לא נודרין ולא מעריכין מפני שאין בהם דעת:

source_first_checklist.observation: Explicit inclusion question and answer: discerning minor near majority, no numeric age invented.

source_first_checklist.observation: Explicit inclusion question; unsightly and boil-afflicted person included as fixed-valuation subjects.

source_first_checklist.observation: Hypothetical reading of נדר בערכך would link fixed valuation to market value; preserve both positive and negative branches, not final rule.

source_first_checklist.observation: נפשות כל דהו defeats prior market-value limitation; not unlimited erasure of prior definite-sex restrictions.
Question why universal נודרין; answer says נידרין needs it. Distinguish declarant and subject.

source_first_checklist.observation: Question on נידרין; two proposed group inclusions rejected as already explicit.

source_first_checklist.observation: Under-month and foreigner suggestions initially challenged as explicit; under-month accepted with teaches then explains answer. Fixed valuation NOT asserted for under-month child.
